items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And so on the last record, “The Good News Blues,” we did Mr. CP and we dedicated it to him. So we took all of his pet phrases and put it together on that song.

ctx.x: It was Curtis Peagler, Red Callender, Jimmy Noone, see and John Harris. Now John Harris is the only one left from our old group. You know he played with Carmen McRae, he played with Horace Silver, and quite a few. And he’s one of the most sensitive drummers. Jo Jones was crazy about him.
